probability_targets.interpretation: Repair and final PAC probabilities are separate. The union-bound sum applies only to the conjunction of both stage guarantees; final error alone uses alpha_final.

exact_wor_and_remainder.reference_scope: Exact rational capitals on a nested null grid; production-grid coverage exhaustively counted over every ternary order.

grid_prefix_inversion.statement_checked: lower is the predecessor of the first never-rejected grid null; any never-rejected true grid ceiling controls the reported lower bound.
grid_prefix_inversion.limitation: The constructed continuous pattern is a logical counterexample for arbitrary rejection sets, not a claimed path generated by this betting implementation.

frozen_candidates_and_remainders.limitation: The base estimator is replaced by a deterministic observable model to isolate search, freezing, oracle accounting, and repair logic. This does not validate Dawid-Skene estimation or newly proposed G1/G2/S1 implementations.

fixed_input_pac_manual_oracle.reference: scalar exact rational capital for every threshold; manually formed union of gold-query index sets

random_stream_wiring.limitation: No claim of independence can be established solely by inspecting integer seeds; scores/predictions must be frozen before independent calibration draws.

full_search_monte_carlo.limitation: The full production search and certifier run with a deterministic observable base estimator. These are synthetic implementation checks, not E4 coupling-sweep experiments.

frozen_input_pac_monte_carlo.limitation: Each frozen synthetic input is conditional and fixed. This does not test annotation-panel variability, audit-trained score leakage, or a general population guarantee.

warnings.message: The draft's bisection oracle is invalid for arbitrary nonmonotone rejection sets. This package checks the discrete prefix and one-unrejected-grid-null implication; it does not claim domination of a continuous first-unrejected bound.
AST seed inspection verifies the named existing runner and distinct stream wiring, not statistical independence of arbitrary callers or future v8 score-training code.

limitations: These checks are not proofs of the general statistical guarantees.

Exhaustive coverage is limited to ternary finite populations with N at most 8; every distinct ordering has its exact combinatorial probability. Mean coverage compares the exact rational value of the reported floating-point lower endpoint to the exact population mean and tracks the maximum over every prefix.
Exact rational capital agreement is checked on the configured nested reference grid; the complete 401-point production grid is used for exhaustive coverage and all simulations.
The grid check does not use bisection or assume monotonicity across nulls, and it does not assert a continuous-bound dominance property.
One-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds describe each fixed simulation fixture; a bound above nominal is inconclusive rather than proof of failure.

Simulation classification is fail when the one-sided 95% lower bound exceeds nominal, pass_with_margin when its upper bound is below nominal, and inconclusive otherwise. Several fixtures are tested without simultaneous adjustment, so simulation flags can occur by chance; deterministic defects have separate check IDs.
Inputs are assumed valid: truthful owned labels, finite nonnegative uncertainties for unowned items, permissible alpha/epsilon, and frozen predictions/scores.
G1/G2/S1 text features, cross-fitting, model fitting, real annotation panels, and E1-E4 study outcomes are outside this verification run.
